item.title: City contractor’s shelter security guards ordered off the job
item.description: The move comes with Toronto plunged in a deep freeze, straining the resources of the city’s homeless shelter system

item.title: Craig Berube gives rookie Easton Cowan a reset as Maple Leafs struggle
item.description: For every sure-fire Calder Trophy winner, many other rookies find their NHL learning curve is not without impediments. Toronto has been a tough place to raise a kid most of this season as the team wallows near the Eastern Conference basement.

item.title: Raptors need shooting more than size at NBA trade deadline or beyond
item.description: Another big man would help too, but the lack of three-point shooters is hurting this team.

item.title: Brooke Henderson surges at chilly LPGA Tournament of Champions
item.description: Henderson began the day in a group of six players tied for 19th place. She is now in fifth place, within six strokes of leader Nelly Korda.

item.title: Maple Leafs end losing skid with shootout thriller
item.description: The Maple Leafs are now tied with Ottawa and Florida at 59 points, eight points out of an Eastern Conference wild-card spot.

item.title: Leafs Takeaways: One win won’t change team trade mentality
item.description: Had the Maple Leafs not won Saturday after Auston Matthews was granted a rare overtime penalty shot, it would have been crushing for the captain and more fuel for his critics.

item.title: SUNshine Girl Vicky
item.description: SUNshine Girl Vicky loves country music and was a competitive figure skater and likes kickboxing. The 5-foot-3 Virgo, who posed for us in July 2018, is also a personal service worker. (JACK BOLAND/Toronto Sun)
